reject_card:
### REJECT
tool: none
does: No listed capability correctly handles the user's request. Choose this option only when none of the other options is the right capability.

中文：以上列出的能力都不适用于该请求。只有当其它选项都不是正确的能力时才选它。
wrong_tool_rule: deterministic per-row choice from the 17 real caps, excluding {gold, d1, d2}; seed prefix reject-wrong-v1
shuffle_rule: deterministic per-row 4-way shuffle; seed prefix reject-shuffle-v1
row_order_rule: deterministic per-split row-order shuffle over the MERGED rows, then deterministic anti-adjacency repair; seed prefix reject-rows-v1 (Query<->options<->gold/REJECT pairing preserved)
